author: mmarriot
body:
#### PR description:

This adds `CaloRecHitTableProducer` to PhysicsTools/NanoAOD. It writes the rechits of one ECAL or HCAL collection, one row per hit in collection order: the raw `detId`, `energy`, `time`, and the global position `x`, `y`, `z` of the cell from `CaloGeometry` (the position used for PF rechits). It is a template on the collection type, registered as four modules: `EcalRecHitTableProducer` (EB, EE or ES), `HBHERecHitTableProducer`, `HFRecHitTableProducer` and `HORecHitTableProducer`. Options: a string `cut`, `precision` for the float columns, and `skipNonExistingSrc`.

With it, ECAL and HCAL hit-level studies (occupancy, timing, noise, validation of the local and PF reconstruction, ML inputs) can run on NanoAOD instead of RECO.

It complements #52573, which writes the hits of each calorimeter cluster as `detId` and energy `fraction`, but not the hits themselves. Joining the two on `detId` gives every cluster's hits with their energy, time and position, e.g. for clustering validation or cluster-level ML inputs. They are separate PRs because each is useful alone: #52573 also joins with the HGCal rechit tables of PhysicsTools/TruthInfo, and these tables serve ECAL and HCAL hit studies without clusters.

This is a new module because the release has no NanoAOD table of all ECAL and HCAL rechits with positions: `SimpleFlatTableProducer` (used by DPGAnalysis/HcalNanoAOD) cannot read the geometry, and `PFRecHitFlatTableProducer` (PhysicsTools/TruthInfo) writes only PF rechits, 7% of the EB rechits in a Phase-2 ttbar event without pileup. More columns can be added as an extension table with the same `src` and `cut`.

HcalNanoAOD names its tables `RecHitHBHE`, `RecHitHF` and `RecHitHO`. A job that writes both must use other names for one of them, or run the HcalNanoAOD tables as extensions of these.

No existing workflow uses the new modules, so no changes are expected.

#### PR validation:

- New unit tests in `testPhysicsToolsNanoAODTP` cover the four modules, the positions of EB, EE, ES, HB, HF and HO cells, `cut`, `precision` and missing input.
- On Phase-2 ttbar RECO at 0 and 200 pileup (10 events each) and Run 3 data RECO (50 events), every table matches a FWLite read of its collection (DetId, energy, time and order; 620k hits, no mismatch), and the positions are identical to those of `PFRecHitFlatTableProducer` for the same DetIds. The HcalNanoAOD tables run as extensions of these.
- Timing and size, 1 thread, precision 14: at 200 pileup, 0.96 ms/event and 122 kB/event for EB, HBHE, HF and HO (11.6k hits); on Run 3 data, 1.2 ms/event and 80 kB/event for all six collections (9.2k hits).

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: Add NanoAOD tables of calorimeter rechits with their positions
